items.q: Do you remove all types of cardboard waste?
a: We remove all cardboard types, including moving boxes, shipping materials, retail packaging, and industrial bales from both homes and businesses.

items.q: How much does cardboard removal cost?
a: Prices start at $125 for basic removal. Larger commercial projects receive volume discounts with free on-site estimates.

items.q: What areas do you serve for cardboard removal?
a: We cover Markham, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, and the surrounding GTA areas. Confirm service availability for your specific location when booking.

items.q: Can I schedule a same-day cardboard pickup?
